question_text: Was Reykjavík City hacked in the November 2026 cyberattack?
answer_text: Yes, by its own account. Reykjavík City says attackers breached some of its computer systems on Nov 25, and it took many of its online services offline to protect them. It has not yet said what data, if any, was taken.
label: Confirmed

question_text: Are Reykjavík City's online services back?
answer_text: Not fully. At our last check the city's website still said its online services were disrupted, and online financial-assistance applications were unavailable. The city aimed to bring most systems back over the weekend.
label: Confirmed

question_text: Was personal data taken in the Reykjavík City cyberattack?
what_would_settle_it: Reykjavík City, CERT-IS or Iceland's data protection authority saying what data the attackers reached and whether any was copied.

question_text: Who attacked Reykjavík City, and was it ransomware?
what_would_settle_it: The city, CERT-IS or the police saying how the attackers got in and who they were, or a credible outlet reporting a claim by a named group.

question_text: Did the hackers get passwords and into a Reykjavík City database?
answer_text: RÚV reports so, citing its own sources, but the city has not confirmed it. The city says it is resetting all passwords and access keys in the affected systems and is still working out what data may have been accessed.
label: Reported

question_text: Is the Reykjavík City attack linked to the Blue Lagoon or 1984 Hosting attacks?
answer_text: Nothing public shows that. A CERT-IS official said the Blue Lagoon attack that day shares similarities but could not say they are related. The firm helping the city says other, unnamed Icelandic systems linked to it were entered too.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: CERT-IS, the police or the organisations themselves saying whether the attacks are connected.

question_text: What should Reykjavík residents do while services are down?
answer_text: Online applications for financial assistance are unavailable, and the city asks people to apply at one of its offices during opening hours. The city says it will post more on its website as work progresses.
label: Confirmed
